messages:
Maya (People Ops): Quick heads-up — we pushed a small but important wording change to the caregiver leave section of the employee handbook this morning (clarifies eligibility for people who take intermittent leave and how parental/adoptive leave interacts with short-term disability). Please review and ack by EOD next Tuesday if you own manager signoffs for a team. Link: https://docs.redwoodinc.com/people/handbook/caregiver-leave :page_facing_up:

Maya (People Ops): Also launching a short compliance microlearning (10–12 min) that covers the updated leave rules + data-handling expectations for leave requests. Completion required for all managers and people-ops-facing ICs by Apr 12. Tracking sheet and LMS link below. If you manage contractors, see Q&A below on whether to include them.

Maya (People Ops): Tracking & instructions — please: 1) confirm your teams in column B of the sheet, 2) add manager confirmations in column D, 3) mark module completion using the LMS completion export (instructions inline). Tracker: https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1Xxx-TrackerLink

Maya (People Ops): LMS bulk export for admins (use if you want to pull completions for your teams):

```
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $LMS_API_TOKEN" \
  "https://lms.internal/api/v1/completions?course_id=caregiver_2026&since=2026-03-01" \
  -o completions.csv
```
Add the CSV to the tracker tab "LMS Import" and we will reconcile.

Omar (People Ops): PR: I left a suggested alternate wording in the doc (comments). If Legal signs off we will snapshot the handbook and push the policy email tomorrow.

Lina (Legal): Reviewed — wording looks good. Two tiny edits to the definition of "eligible caregiver" (I added examples). I also recommend we clarify retroeffective timeframe (see comment). Once Omar resolves, we can sign-off.

Sam R (Eng Manager): Quick question — do contractors need to take the microlearning? Our contractor manager flagged that some staffing vendors require separate agreements.

Jules (HR Support): For now, mandatory only for W2 employees and full-time contractors who are manager-facing (i.e., have hiring/people decisions). If a vendor contract requires it, please escalate to people-ops@redwood for an exception. We'll add a contractor column in the tracker.

Sam R (Eng Manager): Got it — thanks. I'll update my sheet column after I confirm with my lead contractors.

Maya (People Ops): Thanks Sam. Also: if teams want an optional 30-min drop-in to go over the new wording + Q&A, we can run two sessions next week — Tue 11am PT and Thu 4pm PT. RSVP on the tracker (column G).

Sam R (Eng Manager): I'll take the Tue slot.

Lina (Legal): FYI — for EU people we'll need to keep proof of consent/ack in retention for 3 years per local regs. Please make sure the tracker has a flag for "EU" headcount.

Maya (People Ops): Good call — added an "EU" column.

HR-bot: Reminder scheduled — automated reminder to managers who haven’t confirmed will run on Apr 5.

Sam R (Eng Manager): Small ask — can the managers' confirmation be a simple Slack emoji on the sheet or do you need full names? I can only spare 2 min per team. :sweat_smile:

Maya (People Ops): Emoji check is fine for initial ack, but we need a full timestamped confirmation row in the tracker for audit (we'll fill in the timestamp when we reconcile imports).

Omar (People Ops): Action items: - Managers to mark teams in Column B (by Mar 30) - Managers to RSVP to drop-ins if needed (Col G) - Managers + manager-facing ICs complete microlearning by Apr 12 - People Ops to export LMS completions on Apr 13 and reconcile with the tracker.

Jules (HR Support): I'll follow up with a short template we can paste into manager 1:1s to nudge folks without spamming everyone.

Sam R (Eng Manager): Template would be great. Also, is there a way to show a per-team completion % on the tracker? That helps our weekly 1:1 metric.

Maya (People Ops): Yes — I added a "Completion %" calculated column on the tracker. If your sheet is linked to the import tab it will update after we run the import.

Lina (Legal): One last note: please keep any medical details out of Slack threads — use the secure form linked in the handbook for intake.

Maya (People Ops): Agreed — added a bold reminder at the top of the handbook page. Thanks all. :heart:
